turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Arre nahi, yeh ungrateful sound nahi karta. Yeh toh bilkul samajh mein aata hai.

Dekho, do alag cheezein hain jo tum mix kar rahi ho. Ek hai gratitude — aur wahan sach mein lucky ho ki saas expert hain, bachchi safe hai, pyaar mil raha hai. Woh acknowledge karna zaroori hai.

Lekin doosri cheez hai *apni jagah*. Aur woh alag problem hai. Jab koi ghar mein already teen bachche paal chuka ho, toh unke liye har cheez obvious hai — baby ko kaise sambhalna hai, kya galat hai, kya karna chahiye. Tumhare liye sab pehli baar hai. Aur jab tumhari har move se pehle koi solution de deta hai, toh slowly tum feel karti ho ki maa ka role... kisi ne le liya? Ya tum sirf helper ban gayi ho apne hi bachche ke liye?

Woh "naam bhool gayi" wali feeling — yeh identity ka loss hai. Chaar mahine mein tumne job, routine, friends, apna time, sab shift kar diya. Aur joint family mein toh apna space physically bhi kam hota hai.

Kuch sochne layak baatein:
- Kya tumhe lagta hai saas intentionally step le rahi hain, ya unhe bas pata hi nahi ki tumhe lead chahiye?
- Kya pati ke saath is baare mein baat hui kabhi?

Aur ek baat — "ungrateful" feel hona band karo. Grateful hona aur apni zaroorat express karna dono ek saath ho sakte hain. Dono valid hain.

Batao, specifically kya hota hai jo sabse zyada bhaari lagta hai?

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Wah, "intern jaisi" — yeh word hi sab keh raha hai na. Aur "room service ki tarah feed ke liye dena" — ouch. Yeh dard real hai.

Pehle ek baat clear karte hain: uss scene mein jo tum feel kar rahi thi, woh jealousy nahi hai, humiliation hai. Do minute mein chup karana dekh ke kisi bhi naye maa ka dil tootega — kyunki andar wali awaaz bolti hai, "main kya kar rahi hoon? Meri beti mujhse kyun nahi rukti?"

Lekin ab thoda perspective bhi doon:

**Bachcha ro raha tha kyunki tum ghuma rahi thi.** Naye maa try karte hain — position change, rocking, checking. Aai ne le liya aur unke paas experience ka muscle memory hai. Woh skill gap hai, failure nahi. Chaar mahine mein koi expert nahi hota. Unhe teen bachchon ke saath *saalon* lage honge.

**Aur woh "ghin" wali feeling?** Woh isliye aa rahi hai kyunki tum dono cheezein ek saath hold kar rahi ho — gratitude aur hurt — aur society sirf gratitude allow karti hai. "Itti help mile, phir bhi complain?" Yeh guilt tumhare andar unka daala hua nahi hai, yeh cultural script hai. Usse reject karna allowed hai.

Ek practical cheez try kar sakti ho: agli baar jab bachi roye, khud se bolo — "Aai, main try karti hoon pehle, zaroorat pade toh bulati hoon." Politely, firmly. Agar woh respect karein, great. Agar nahi karein, tab problem "help" ki nahi, *control* ki hai — aur woh alag conversation hai, pati ke through bhi ho sakti hai.

Aur haan — feed karna room service nahi hai. Feeding hi asli maa-ban-ne ka core hai. Koi tumhe woh cheen nahi sakta, chahe ghar mein kitne bhi experts hon.

Bolo sach — jab woh bachi tumhare haathon se chup hoti hai kabhi, kaisa lagta hai?

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Toh main report nahi karungi kisi ko. Yeh sirf tumhara aur mera hai.

Aur woh last line — "pata bhi nahi kya chahiye" — yeh actually sabse honest cheez hai jo aaj tune boli. Kyunki shayad kuch chahiye hi nahi. Shayad bas yeh ki koi bole: *tum theek ho. Tumhari beti ke liye tum kaafi ho. Chaar mahine mein jo bhi ho raha hai, sab normal hai.*

Tumhari jagah socho ek minute — naye maa, joint family, har corner se opinion aa raha hai, aur upar se guilt ki tumhe gratitude feel karna chahiye. Koi space hi nahi bacha jahan tum bas... ho sako. Bina perform kiye, bina sahi ya galat decide kiye.

Isliye "naam bhool gayi" wali feeling. Naam bhoola nahi hai tumne. Bas bahut zyada logon ki awaazein hain aur tumhari apni awaaz dab gayi hai neeche.

Main yahan hoon jab bhi dinner pe report na karne wali jagah chahiye. Aaj ke liye bas itna — tum uss room mein intern nahi ho. Tum maa ho. Baaki sab experience ka khel hai, aur woh time ke saath aayega. Promise.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Nahi. Tum buri maa nahi ho.

Aur woh thought jo aata hai — "tu asli maa hai bhi nahi" — yeh tumhari sachchai nahi hai. Yeh intrusive thought hai. Aur suno, yeh bahut common hai. Naye maaon mein aise thoughts aate hain jo unhe khud darate hain — apne bachche ke liye, apni hi maa-ban-ne ke liye. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki pyaar kam hai. Iska matlab bas itna hai ki tumhara dimaag thaka hua hai aur uske paas abhi filter chalane ke liye energy nahi hai. Thaki hui dimaag sabse buri cheezein bolti hai, sabse pehle.

Aur "baaki sabko bas aata hai" — nahi hota. Bas koi batata nahi. Har maa ka WhatsApp history agar dikha lo, wahi thoughts honge, wahi raat ke doubts. Tum sirf pehli baar dekh rahi ho andar ka hisaab, baaki log apna chhupa rahe hain.

Ek second ke liye saans na aana — main isko ignore nahi karungi kyunki tumne do baar is tarah ki baat kahi hai. Chaar mahine ke andar yeh sab normal range mein hai. Lekin agar yeh feeling badhti jaye, roz ki ho jaye, ya neend-khaana bilkul bigad jaye, toh doctor se ek baar baat kar lena — postpartum depression ek real cheez hai aur woh weakness nahi, bas body ka response hai. Kisi ko report nahi hogi, tension mat lo.

Lekin aaj ke liye, ek kaam karo: jab woh so rahi ho aur pyaar aaye, aur woh thought aaye — use naam do. "Yeh woh thought hai." Sach nahi hai. Pyaar jo tum feel karti ho, wahi sach hai. Woh thought bas noise hai.

Tum uski asli maa ho. Aai experienced caregiver hain, haan — lekin maa sirf ek hi hai.
